documents.title: Campus Room Booking Service - Detailed Design

intent_summary.statement: A booking service that lets students reserve study rooms, accessibly, with a reliable reminder before each slot.

objectives.text: All booking screens meet WCAG 2.2 AA.
Every booking gets a reminder one hour before the slot.

constraints.text: Runs on the existing campus PostgreSQL cluster.

key_assumptions.text: Peak load is the first week of term.

doc_anchors.quote: The service lets students reserve study rooms for one-hour slots across campus.

verdict.label: fit_with_conditions
verdict.rationale: Accessibility and booking flows are sound; reminders fail FR-9 on peak days until the e-mail quota is fixed.
verdict.what_would_change_it: Evidence that the university's contract has a daily quota above 5,000 messages.

findings.title: E-mail plan cannot send peak-day reminders
findings.statement: Section 6.2 states the e-mail service has no daily sending limit, but its published plan allows 2,000 messages a day, below the 5,000 reminders the design sends on exam-week peak days, so most reminders are rejected and FR-9 ('every booking gets a reminder one hour before') fails.

doc_anchors.quote: The selected e-mail service has no daily sending limit, so reminders are sent individually as each slot approaches.

evidence.quote: The Starter plan allows up to 2,000 messages per day.
5,000 peak-day reminders (section 4.1) exceed the 2,000-per-day plan limit.

recommendation.issue: The reminder design depends on a sending limit the chosen plan does not provide.
recommendation.rationale: Reminders over the daily quota are rejected, so the plan, not the design, decides which students get reminders.
recommendation.expected_benefit: FR-9 holds on peak days: every booking receives its reminder.
recommendation.change_summary: In 6.2, state the plan's quota and either move to a plan with at least 10,000 messages a day or send overflow reminders as campus-app push notifications.
recommendation.verification: Peak-day load test: 5,000 reminders in one day, all delivered.

next_step.action: Add the peak-day reminder load test traced to FR-9.

findings.title: Accessibility is verified, not just promised
findings.statement: NFR-7 (WCAG 2.2 AA) is backed by an acceptance criterion that combines automated checks with a manual screen-reader pass on every booking screen, so the accessibility objective is verifiable as written.

doc_anchors.quote: Every booking screen is tested against WCAG 2.2 level AA with automated checks and a manual screen-reader pass.

evidence.quote: Every booking screen is tested against WCAG 2.2 level AA with automated checks and a manual screen-reader pass.

findings.no_change_rationale: Automated checks alone miss screen-reader problems; the manual pass covers them and the criterion is traced to NFR-7. More tooling would not change the outcome.

affected_decisions.justification: Affirms decision D-3 (front end built from the campus design-system components).

sound_areas.why_sound: The accessibility objective is verified by automated and manual testing.

doc_anchors.quote: Every booking screen is tested against WCAG 2.2 level AA with automated checks and a manual screen-reader pass.

unresolved.text: Peak-day reminder delivery must be demonstrated by test.

next_step.action: Add the peak-day reminder load test traced to FR-9.

decision_registry.statement: The booking front end is built from the campus design-system components.

doc_anchor.quote: D-3 Confirmed: the booking front end is built from the campus design system component library.

evidence_ledger.excerpt: Every booking screen is tested against WCAG 2.2 level AA with automated checks and a manual screen-reader pass.
Peak exam-week days generate about 5,000 bookings, each with one reminder.

evidence_ledger.title: Plans and sending limits
evidence_ledger.excerpt: The Starter plan allows up to 2,000 messages per day.
5,000 peak-day reminders (section 4.1) exceed the 2,000-per-day plan limit.

limitations.text: The university's contract with the e-mail provider was not available; the public plan limits were assumed to apply.

stop_reason.detail: All external premises resolved by a primary source.
